notes.title: ARVIS Punch V2.0
notes.content:
Patch notes:
- Introduced motion capture animations.
- Upgraded boxers animation controller system.
- Upgraded boxer AI through the coaching of a real boxing trainer.
- Boxers are now able to dodge and cover.
- Dynamic KO based on final impact.
- Upgraded player fighting systems.
